component.name: AppTile
component.script: ' Tiles get reused as the grid scrolls, so every tile resets the name bar. ' Only the My Channel tile sets shortDescriptionLine1, which shows the owner's name under its image. sub showContent() item = m.top.itemContent logo = m.top.findNode("logo") logo.uri = item.HDPosterUrl name = item.shortDescriptionLine1 hasName = (name <> invalid and name <> "") m.top.findNode("bar").visible = hasName m.top.findNode("name").visible = hasName if hasName then logo.height = 236 m.top.findNode("name").text = name else logo.height = 300 end if end sub
